summary: Petrol pump management system with sales tracking, shift management, and staff administration
architectural_notes: Sales entries support backdating with custom date selection
Totalizer-based fuel volume calculation for petrol and diesel
Shift management includes timestamp tracking for historical data

existing_features.title: Add a date picker field to the new sale form to allow entering or selecting a custom date for backdated sales entries
Add open totalizer and end totalizer numeric input fields to the new sale form
Automatically calculate and display the volume of petrol or diesel dispensed based on the difference between end totalizer and open totalizer readings
Add start shift date and time picker fields to the Start New Shift dialog

new_feature_requests.summary: Add date selection for backdated sales entries in new sale option
Add open and end totalizer fields in sales that calculate fuel volume difference
Add start shift date and time fields to Start New Shift option for backdated entries
Store open totalizer and end totalizer readings with each sale record in the backend
